description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取跟踪某美股指数的公募基金列表（目前只包含大陆公募基金）。可按指数代码批量查询，返回基金名称、基金代码、基金简写名、地区、市场、交易所等数据。当用户想了解某个指数由哪些场内/场外基金跟踪时，调用此接口。
description.en: Fetch tracking fund data for US indices, returning fund name, code, short name, area, market, and exchange. Used when understanding which ETFs/index funds track a specific US index, analyzing premium/discount, or selecting investment products.
